subtitle: A hidden-office layout with a foldable agent list, a Draw button on pictures, and Runs and Insights in plain numbers.

cards.title: Hide office, with a real layout
cards.text: With the office hidden, the agent list folds and opens on hover, the profile card docks above the chat, and the chat stays centred.

cards.title: Runs and Insights, in plain numbers
cards.text: Runs shows numbers and two plain charts. Insights shows what keeps going wrong in each workflow, and the run panel is a strip of steps.
